messages.subject: release of seewave 1.7.0
parts:
Dear seewave users,

A new version of seewave (1.7.0) was deposited on CRAN some days ago.

This version includes, among others:

. ggspectro(): a new function to plot a spectrogram using ggplot2.
. synth2(): a new function to synthesize sound with envelope amplitude
and instantaneous frequency (tonal model). This function may be very
useful for those who need to modify an original sound or generate a
brand new one for playback experiments.
. ACI(): a new function to compute the Acoustic Complexity Index
following Pieretti et al. (2011).

Thanks very much to Laurent Lellouch for his contribution.

Some new examples are available on the webpage: http://rug.mnhn.fr/seewave.

Enjoy,

Jerome
